classifier.useWhen: User asks for headlines, taglines, short-form copy, or creative wording.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for factual documentation or legal text.

label: Storyboarding
description: Plan a visual, narrative, product, or media sequence.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for scenes, flows, visual sequence, or narrative structure.

label: Name Generation
description: Generate names for products, features, projects, or campaigns.

classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for legal trademark clearance.

label: Concept Development
description: Develop creative concepts, themes, or directions.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to develop an idea or concept.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for script or scene dialogue.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for legal policy review.

label: Brand Voice

classifier.useWhen: User asks for voice or tone direction.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for literal translation only.
